evals.prompt: I want to trigger a Trigger.dev task via MCP, wait for it to complete, and if it fails, get the error details. What MCP tools do I use?
evals.expected_output: Should show: get_current_worker for the task slugs, get_task_schema for the payload schema, trigger_task, wait_for_run_to_complete, get_run_details for errors
expectations: Mentions get_task_schema (payload schemas are not returned by get_current_worker)

evals.prompt: I am wiring the Trigger.dev MCP server into an agent that must never deploy, trigger or cancel anything on our production instance. How do I configure it?
evals.expected_output: Should put --readonly in the args of the trigger.dev mcp server command (it is not an install-mcp flag), and list the write tools it hides
expectations: Uses trigger.dev mcp with --readonly in the server args
Does not recommend install-mcp --readonly (that option does not exist)
Names write tools it hides such as deploy, trigger_task and cancel_run
Mentions that start_dev_server and switch_profile are not hidden, or offers --dev-only for environment restriction
